attacks.claim: The log line carries a 10-hex-char SHA-256 fingerprint of the tenant API key. It is not the key and is not practically reversible for high-entropy keys. It is also redundant, since tenant.id is already logged, and it sits close to the 'keys must never appear in logs' rule.

The upstream 429 retry sleeps up to 5s without checking whether the client aborted. A disconnected client keeps the handler waiting until the timer fires, though the second upstream call is still passed the abort signal.
The upstream-429 retry path, including Retry-After parsing and the 5s cap, has no tests. Only the bucket is covered.
